exercise.title: Sing the 3rd, the 4th and the 5th
exercise.why: A leap lands in tune when you hear the landing note before you sing it, so the game gives you only Do and the name of the leap.

cells.text: Press Start below: Do sounds, and the leap to sing shows by name, a 3rd, a 4th or a 5th. Hear the landing note in your head first, then sing it on "oo" and hold it until it counts. Press Next for another leap, from a new Do. If a leap misses, press Restart to hear Do again.
